description: Load product attributes and their values in one call — "Size: S,M,L", "Colour: Red,Blue,Green" — the axes variants are built from. For one axis use create_option. Attribute names are unique per company: a `creates` row whose name already exists is REJECTED (that row only), so read get_options first and send existing ones through `updates`. On `updates`, values are APPEND-ONLY: the list you pass is merged into what is there and existing values are never renamed or removed, because variants reference them by name and would be orphaned. Renaming the attribute itself does cascade to its variants. To remove a value, use the cabinet. This creates no products and no variants — it only defines the axes. Rows are independent and per-row failures come back in the reply. Max 500 rows per call. BEFORE CALLING: show the merchant a preview of the first few rows, state the EXACT number of rows and which resource they hit, and get an explicit yes. There is NO undo and no dry-run — nothing here validates without writing. If you are unsure a row is right, ask; a wrong bulk import is far more expensive to repair than a question. Afterwards, tell the merchant what landed: an import done here does NOT appear in the cabinet's Recent Imports list, which only records uploads made through the wizard.
